description: The agent roster of a dataset: `agents.csv` at the dataset root, one row per agent, mapping the dataset-local `agent_index` to the global `agent_id` and carrying core per-agent attributes. Referenced by every table that carries an `agent_id` (e.g., `Response` and `StudyflowLog` in the trial family).

tables.name: Agent
tables.description: One agent in the dataset. Shipped as `agents.csv` at the dataset root, one row per agent: the mapping between the dataset-local `agent_index` and the global `agent_id`, plus core per-agent attributes.
notes: Datasets may add custom columns for attributes not specified here (e.g., handedness, education, gender identity); the columns below are the shared core.
Per-agent data availability is deliberately not recorded here — it is derivable from each agent's `studyflow_log.csv`, which lists every run the agent began, with its status.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: A unique identifier assigned to the agent (typically unique within a data collection institution or research group), used to determine whether the same agent participated in multiple studies. May be created using a custom procedure (e.g., a UUID).

fields.name: agent_index
fields.description: The dataset-local label of the agent: the string `agent_` followed by a zero-padded ordinal (e.g., `agent_015`). It names the agent's data folder and is unique within the dataset.

fields.name: agent_type
fields.description: The kind of agent that generated the data.

values.description: A non-human animal (e.g., a mouse, a primate).
An artificial agent (e.g., a computational model, an AI system).

fields.name: age
fields.description: Age of the agent at the start of the study, in years.

fields.name: sex
fields.description: Sex of the agent, as recorded by the study.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Primary language of the agent, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g., `en`, `fr-BE`).
